probes.query: How does the chat API set up resumable streaming so a dropped client can reconnect to an in-progress response?
expectedFacts: getStreamContext wraps createResumableStreamContext({ waitUntil: after }) in a try/catch; when REDIS_URL is set, consumeSseStream generates a stream id, persists it with createStreamId({ streamId, chatId }), then registers the SSE stream with streamContext.createNewResumableStream(streamId, () => sseStream). If Redis/context setup is unavailable, the route skips resumable streaming gracefully.
probes.author: ts-author
probes.notes: Verified: `grep -n "function getStreamContext" app/(chat)/api/chat/route.ts` -> :50; `grep -n "createResumableStreamContext({ waitUntil: after })" app/(chat)/api/chat/route.ts` -> :52 (returns null in catch). `grep -n "REDIS_URL\|createStreamId\|createNewResumableStream" app/(chat)/api/chat/route.ts` -> REDIS_URL guard :306, createStreamId :313, createNewResumableStream :314. `grep -n "export async function createStreamId" lib/db/queries.ts` -> :597.

probes.query: Where is Stripe billing / the subscription checkout integration implemented?
expectedFacts: The ai-chatbot repo has no Stripe billing or subscription/checkout integration; rate limiting is done via entitlementsByUserType, not paid plans.
probes.author: ts-author
probes.notes: Verified ABSENT: `rg -ni "stripe|paywall|checkout session" .` -> 0 results (exit 1, no output). No payment integration exists; the agent must confirm the negative rather than force-match entitlements.

probes.query: Find the WebSocket transport used to push streaming chat tokens to the browser.
expectedFacts: The ai-chatbot repo does not use WebSockets; streaming is delivered over HTTP via the AI SDK data stream / resumable-stream, so there is no WebSocket transport to find.
probes.author: ts-author
probes.notes: Verified ABSENT: `rg -ni "websocket|socket\.io|new WebSocket" .` -> 0 results (exit 1). Streaming uses HTTP/data-stream (see getStreamContext / data-stream-provider), not WebSockets. Tempting near-miss is the streaming code, but no WS transport exists.
